g.title: LyonRank3Convo5 begins.
g.text: LyonRank3Convo5 begins.

g.title: j3652313205
g.text: It was a thunderstorm the night that "Cardinal Dimanche" came to us. He stood in the sanctuary of the church, untouched by the gale that raged outside.

g.title: j1340855724
g.text: That should have served as my first cause for concern. Instead, I bowed my head to him and greeted him as I would any new envoy from the Holy Mother.

g.title: j2667623943
g.text: We had been expecting a new Cardinal since our last one had departed several months earlier from illness, after all.

g.title: j3290787021
g.text: Dimanche greeted me with a warm smile and a firm handshake. I asked him if his journey was long. I will never forget his reply.

g.title: j1292810979
g.text: "It was difficult... but it was not long."

g.title: j270387946
g.text: It puzzled me at the time, as did the fact that his greatcoat was bone dry. But I dismissed it, as all are wont to do when one is faced with the unusual.

g.title: j2552020663
g.text: And I did not have time to consider it, as Marie in her eagerness arrived a moment later.

g.title: j2264223680
g.text: He knelt down to greet her at her level in her chair, and took her hands in his. I should have seen the manipulation for what it was.

g.title: j3737984557
g.text: He was not the only devil to arrive on our doorstep in a storm, after all.

g.title: j1928339452
g.text: Boolean LyonEntrati1 is now true.

g.title: j2100050873
g.text: Check boolean MarieEntrati1

g.title: j1594028918
g.text: The other devil being Roathe?

g.title: j2100050873->j1594028918
g.text: true

g.title: j2100050873->j1594028918
g.text: false

g.title: j2671716751
g.text: She tells this story very differently.

g.title: j2100050873->j2671716751
g.text: true

g.title: j1303127658
g.text: She still believe in his good intentions. Do you?

g.title: j2100050873->j1303127658
g.text: true

g.title: j863078201
g.text: I take it you aren't an ally of Entrati?

g.title: j2100050873->j863078201
g.text: false

g.title: j3615645525
g.text: Yes. But that is a tale for another day. If I begin speaking of him, my already foul mood will become...

g.title: j3405383751
g.text: Yes. She would.

g.title: j2239716395
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1787328747
g.text: After enduring his lies and betrayal, and while we continue to suffer his manipulation of Marie, would you have me be? No, I most certainly am not.

g.title: j1122285290
g.text: ...untenable. I would much rather focus my current mood upon Entrati's misdeeds, if it is all the same to you.

g.title: j701847011
g.text: She tells me that you see things that others don't, sometimes.

g.title: j741871526
g.text: And?

g.title: j911945148
g.text: Marie believes the best in all souls. It is a skill she has honed and perfected and polished as a shield against the world around her.

g.title: j3240122672
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1428371468
g.text: Check boolean RoatheSerum1

g.title: j3085957487
g.text: And what would you make of that statement, were it to be true, Drifter?

g.title: j3467620634
g.text: "And," nothing. I have told you how I witnessed the event, as the truth of my experience of it. Nothing more.

g.title: j669561565
g.text: Marie doesn't have all the facts about what Entrati is truly capable of, and all the horrible things he has done in the name of "progress" and now "redemption."

g.title: j2121289668
g.text: Marie is a grown woman. While I admire your desire to protect her, she can make her own decisions on what she chooses to believe and in whom she chooses to have faith.

g.title: j2582284447
g.text: Fouling our bodies, destroying our futures, corrupting our pasts - all this, perhaps I could forgive.

g.title: j1447760957
g.text: Entrati might not have the best beside manner, but he's trying to save the universe.

g.title: j1428371468->j1447760957
g.text: true

g.title: j1428371468->j1447760957
g.text: false

g.title: j3038637279
g.text: Did he force you into becoming a protoframe, like Roathe?

g.title: j1428371468->j3038637279
g.text: true

g.title: j4152895887
g.text: Of course. Why are you upset at Entrati?

g.title: j1428371468->j4152895887
g.text: false

g.title: j2821822155
g.text: Check boolean LyonVisions1

g.title: j2115467972
g.text: Trust is a stained glass window. Delicate in its creation. Beautiful in its splendor. Tragic in its breaking. And dangerous once destroyed.

g.title: j311819194
g.text: Trust is a stained glass window. Delicate in its creation. Beautiful in its splendor. Tragic in its breaking. And dangerous once destroyed.

g.title: j2666468364
g.text: But to see how he has warped Marie... used her faith in the goodness of others to his own ends?

g.title: j2166214836
g.text: No. I had my reason for accepting the elixer. I knew what twisted creature it would make of me. As did Marie.

g.title: j779796940
g.text: I guess I don't particularly care either way?

g.title: j2821822155->j779796940
g.text: true

g.title: j2821822155->j779796940
g.text: false

g.title: j294110515
g.text: My only question is, if you are seeing things, do your visions bother you?

g.title: j2821822155->j294110515
g.text: true

g.title: j2821822155->j294110515
g.text: false

g.title: j49593869
g.text: What you said the other day - it had me wondering if you're all right, is all.

g.title: j2821822155->j49593869
g.text: true

g.title: j2207289928
g.text: I'm just wondering if you're all right, is all.

g.title: j2821822155->j2207289928
g.text: false

g.title: j385121293
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j3327665805
g.text: In the warm light of Sol, she basks in its light, unable to see the faults that form upon its surface. Unable to hear the cracks that deepen.

g.title: j115001877
g.text: This, I shall never forgive. This, I wish to beat from his flesh with my thurible until he begs for salvation.

g.title: j1986704985
g.text: We were not... forcibly broken, like the devil. Part of my heart feels for Roathe for what he has endured.

g.title: j1630036363
g.text: Then I see no need to continue this conversation.

g.title: j3191366718
g.text: I will be quite blunt in saying that I do not know how to answer that, Drifter.

g.title: j1630493712
g.text: Boolean LyonAllRight is now true.

g.title: j1817752084
g.text: Would that I could take from her the corruption he had sown into her mind. I can only pray that you might succeed where I have failed.

g.title: j49365754
g.text: Unaware of the shards of her own masterpiece would soon be turned against her. Choosing to blind herself to what will inevitably follow.

g.title: j1736150981
g.text: Then he opens his mouth to speak.

g.title: Chat ends.
g.text: Chat ends.

g.title: j922871941
g.text: All my years, I have seen horrors the likes of which would send others into the asylums. More tragically, now and again, my visions would come to pass.

g.title: j223002877
g.text: Am I "all right?" I will be quite blunt in saying that I do not know how to answer that, Drifter.

g.title: j944546954
g.text: -F. Lyon Allard

g.title: j3923673152
g.text: Would that I could bear that suffering in her stead, how gladly I would have it tattooed into my soul. But this is for her, and her alone.

g.title: j4029766741
g.text: You have to remember how he was raised. The environment he had to learn to survive in. He was - is - Orokin.

g.title: j4248253147
g.text: I don't think he is so terrible, honestly. He is growing on me.

g.title: j93136146
g.text: Boolean LyonVisions1 is now true.

g.title: j3657385783
g.text: So I shall seek to prevent this pain instead, Drifter.

g.title: j1210061633
g.text: It doesn't make it right, but it might help you learn to meet him halfway.

g.title: j2091916134
g.text: He's doing what he thinks he has to.

g.title: j468227216
g.text: I would see M. Loid for a creme for that ailment. Lest it spread.

g.title: j3580815831
g.text: Boolean LyonBackstory1 is now true.

g.title: j4240890443
g.text: And if you see in that act any attempt to make her small?

g.title: j1567657718
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j250594981
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j3110852882
g.text: The devil always has a certain charm about him.

g.title: j1988170317
g.text: Don't worry, I won't be lured in by his charm.

g.title: j3549487808
g.text: And as such, I thought them the guidance of Lua. That I was chosen by the Luminaries to carry such a burden. Or so I believed them at the time. Such is the reason I sought to enter the priesthood.

g.title: j3374999055
g.text: May Lua have pity upon your soul.

g.title: j798208902
g.text: In our scripture, one does not negotiate with devils- one casts them out. But they did not prepare us for this particular condition.

g.title: j4146010301
g.text: Perhaps. I am not yet certain there is no doubt in that creature's heart.

g.title: j3287256466
g.text: Add -1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j1775419672
g.text: Add 1 to Thermostat counter

g.title: j4093565285
g.text: You believed the visions were from Lua? You don't anymore?

g.title: j749443416
g.text: What kind of horrors...?

g.title: j2144514618
g.text: And what do you think now?

g.title: j2272977792
g.text: We shall see which path that particular devil chooses to walk in due course, won't we?

g.title: j1053159073
g.text: And that is what troubles me. The devil smiles and speaks sense when all others spout madness.

g.title: j339999859
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j4225489720
g.text: What I believe has become... complicated, as of late, by the introduction of new information.

g.title: j4013347038
g.text: We have only just begun to converse about such things, Drifter. It is not that I not believe that you have seen, first-hand, suffering of the worst order, nor do I believe you would require protection from whatever meagre descriptions I might manage to conjure.

g.title: j3418267296
g.text: Quite simply, Drifter, it would be honest to say that I do not know what to believe.

g.title: j2879233588
g.text: -F. Lyon Allard

g.title: j2033728772
g.text: He catches us at our most unawares - when we are vulnerable. When we are weak. When we are in need of answers.

g.title: j1753781745
g.text: Good. See to it that you are not. I would hate to need to beat some sense into you. You seem like the type to return fire.

g.title: j2652647595
g.text: It merely exhausts me to speak of such things to someone I have only just met, only to have them never come near me again. I would rather not have this happen in a situation where we seem to be forced to work together, for the short term at the very least.

g.title: j1258275069
g.text: Boolean LyonFaith1 is now true.

g.title: j367054140
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j4040959512
g.text: I can handle myself. I promise I won't let him get into my head.

g.title: j1420682141
g.text: You seem to be speaking from experience. What answers did he give you?

g.title: j3033146792
g.text: And then what manner of a strange state would we find ourselves?

g.title: j1218542920
g.text: If you want to wait until you trust me more, I understand.

g.title: j2126076800
g.text: I'm not going anywhere, Lyon. You can trust me.

g.title: j355169233
g.text: But I fear that is all a matter for another day.

g.title: j119256034
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2892593989
g.text: Ones that I fear have... thrown a great many things into doubt. But I fear that is all a matter for another day.

g.title: j1482527573
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j2119174963
g.text: +15 Chemistry

g.title: j3454858796
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j318286331
g.text: Good. See to it that you do not. I would hate to have to beat some sense into you. You seem like the type to return fire.

g.title: j321618815
g.text: Boolean LyonFaith1 is now true.

g.title: j1045510237
g.text: Thank you. It is not that I do not believe that you are earnest in what you write. It is merely that my experience has simply taught me otherwise.

g.title: j355541789
g.text: It is not that I do not believe that you are earnest in what you write. It is merely that my experience has simply taught me otherwise.

g.title: j3654959829
g.text: I will have to beg your forgiveness, and your patience, in the meanwhile.
